home.title: Taqwa · Prayer times & Quran app · Free, no ads, open source
home.og_title: Taqwa · Prayer times, Qibla and the Quran
home.description: Free, open-source Islamic app for Android and iPhone: prayer times, adhan, Qibla, the Quran with recitation and a tasbeeh. No ads, no account, works offline.

support.title: Support · Taqwa
support.description: How to report a problem with Taqwa, what to check when a prayer time looks wrong, and how your data is handled.

privacy.title: Privacy policy · Taqwa
privacy.description: What Taqwa stores on your phone, the one thing it uses the internet for, and what it never does.

timetable.index_description: This month’s and next month’s prayer times for {count} cities, from the same prayer-time engine as the Taqwa app, with the Hijri date and the Qibla for each.
timetable.index_lede: This month and next for {count} cities, calculated exactly as the app calculates them. Anywhere else, the app works wherever you are.
timetable.no_match: No city by that name here yet. The app has more than thirty thousand, and works from your location too.
timetable.title: Prayer times in {city}, {country} · {month} · {brand}
timetable.description: {fajr}, {sunrise}, {dhuhr}, {asr}, {maghrib} and {isha} in {city} for every day of {month}, by the {method} method. Qibla: {qibla}.
timetable.note: Calculated by Taqwa’s own prayer-time engine, the one inside the app, and rebuilt every day. Some mosques add a precautionary minute or two; the app lets you adjust any prayer to match yours. Updated {date}.
timetable.high_latitude: At this latitude the sun does not sink far enough below the horizon on some nights, so on those days {fajr} and {isha} follow the app’s rule for high latitudes: “{rule}”.
timetable.clock_change: The clocks change on {date}; from then on the times are on the new clock ({offset}).
timetable.stale: This timetable is out of date. The app always has today’s times.
timetable.cta_title: Get the adhan at these times
timetable.cta_body: Taqwa calls you to every prayer in {city}, works offline, and never shows an ad.
